beats.say: Ian McKellen was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II in 1991.
That was 33 years ago, which is longer than many of his younger fans have been alive.
His journey began in Burnley, Lancashire, where he was born on 25 May 1939.
In 1958, at just 18 years old, he won a scholarship to the University of Cambridge.
His professional career launched in 1961 when he made his stage debut at the Belgrade Theatre.
He later became a global champion for social movements after coming out as gay in 1988.
His record of service to the arts has made him a true icon of British history.

facts: Sir Ian Murray McKellen was born on 25 May 1939 in Burnley, Lancashire.
He was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II in 1991.
Ian McKellen made his stage debut in 1961 at the Belgrade Theatre.
He came out as gay in 1988 and championed LGBT social movements.
In 1958, McKellen won a scholarship to the University of Cambridge.
